text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait's parliament faces a 13 million dinar budget deficit.
- Kuwait Petroleunm Corporation negotiates partnership in Denmark and Rotterdam oil refineries with international oil companies, KPC official says.
- Chinese trade delegation to visit Kuwait in few days.
- Parliamentarians propose imposing medical insurance on expatriates residing in Kuwait. There are more than one million foreign residents.
- Kuwait Oil Tanker Company allocates $2 million for training programmes.
- Constitutional Court agreed to review a petition by former MP Ali-al-Baghli challenging the result of October's elections.
- Bahrain reiterates stand on Gulf Arab summit. Bahrain had announced earlier that it would not attend the annual summit later this month due to differences with host Qatar.
